links.comparator_used: Original PREVENT model applied as-is, before recalibration to the local population
links.outcome: Calibration, sensitivity, net reclassification improvement and net benefit for 10-year ASCVD risk
links.effect: In men, predicted risk improved from 4.2 to 7.6% and sensitivity from 62% to 80%. NRI was +61% in men and +79% in women. Net benefit increased slightly.
links.quote: The model initially underestimated risk in men, which was corrected by recalibration, improving predicted risk from 4.2 to 7.6% and sensitivity from 62% to 80%.
